summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and developments in India's retail sector, alongside noteworthy business expansions by Reliance.

bullets.text: Kerala High Court hears a law student's challenge against new internship policy restrictions.
Calcutta HC allows Indian Bank's ₹96.65 crore deduction claim for doubtful and loss assets under Income-tax Act.
Reliance Consumer expands its FMCG portfolio with the launch of Joyland Dairy Drinks.
India's consumer and retail sector recorded 127 deals worth $1.92 billion in Q3 2023.
Asian Paints reports a 7% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to ₹1,068 crore, with revenue growing 17% to ₹9,977 crore.
